_notes: status: built = a Jinja template exists under factory/templates, has been rendered for a Stonehurst variant and passed qa.py; mock-only = exists only as hand-written HTML in previews/stonehurst or previews/lindley-scott-house (registered in the fingerprint registry, not yet ported to a template); spec = defined here and in docs/venue-site-factory.md, no template yet. The selector only ever picks 'built' items.
axes use the same 0-100 scale as pairings.json. Missing axes are 'don't care'.
needs lists photo requirements the selector checks against the content photo manifest (min source width for the lead photo, number of photos, orientation).

heroes.label: Full-bleed photo, deep scrim, copy bottom-left, date-check card right
Magazine masthead: giant wordmark + dateline on paper, full-bleed photo beneath, date check in a slim bar
Photo matted inside a generous paper margin, centred wordmark above, handwritten-feel caption, date check below the frame
Typographic cover: headline fills the viewport width, one medium photo and the three facts as a ledger; date check is a single inline row
Text-first left column with facts, tall portrait photo right; no scrim; date check card under the copy
50/50: photo left, solid palette panel right holding copy and the date check; panel colour from the photo
Asymmetric 3-photo grid with the headline occupying one cell
Three cross-fading full-bleed photos with a caption counter; static first frame under reduced motion

spaces.label: 12-column asymmetric cards (7/5, 5/7, 6/6) with capacity chip over the photo
Editorial index: numbered rows (name, use, capacity) with one large photo that swaps on hover/focus; rows stack with their photo on mobile
Alternating full-width bands, one space per band, photo rounded, feature chips
Spec table: thumbnail, name, use, capacity, features as a ruled table; reads like a tech sheet
Horizontal scroll-snap strip of tall 3:4 cards

story.label: Text 7 / portrait photo 5 with offset keyline frame and three big numbers
One large serif passage with drop cap, photo under, credit line
Dated rail (1907 → today) with photo beside
Numbers-first: four big figures in a ruled ledger, two short paragraphs

faq.label: Numbered Q&A, all open, two columns on desktop
Single column, every answer visible, hairline rules

tour.label: Copy + notes left, calendar/slot card right
Heading centred, scheduler card centred under it
Dark band with a single 'Book a tour' CTA (scheduler appears inline when clicked)

gallery.label: No separate gallery; spaces section carries the photography
Horizontal scrolling strip of 3:2 photos with captions
Two photos per row, alternating 7/5 and 5/7, captions

moments.label: Scroll story: five steps of a guest's day, image swaps per step, built only from each space's stated use
A day on the grounds: noon / golden hour / night control shifts a photo set and a colour wash across the section
Guest-count slider; spaces that fit light up, others dim, with the stated capacity rule
The rental day as a 12-hour arc: gates, event, breakdown segments from the venue's own FAQ
Abstract diagram of the spaces as linked nodes (not a map); hovering a node highlights its card
Spring/summer/autumn/winter switch that changes photo sets and captions
Hero photo revealed through a tall pane-shaped mask that widens on scroll
Count-up of the venue's figures when the ledger enters view

voices.label: Soft, sensory, second person; italic emphasis; 'yours alone for the day'
Friendly, plain, hospitable; contractions; 'come walk it with us'
Declarative, specific, magazine dateline energy; numbers up front
Short sentences, no adjectives that aren't facts, labels instead of kickers
